user.title: Connect to Intergas Xtend
user.description:
## Before you continue

The Xtend must be reachable over Wi-Fi from this Home Assistant device.

> **Important:** Because the Wi-Fi adapter will be dedicated to the Xtend network, your Home Assistant server must be connected to your home network and internet via **Ethernet**. Without a wired connection, Home Assistant will lose internet access while the Wi-Fi is connected to the Xtend.

**Step 1 — Activate the Xtend access point**
Press the button on the Xtend unit until the LED blinks purple.

**Step 2 — Connect Home Assistant to the Xtend Wi-Fi**
Go to [Settings → System → Network](/config/network), click on your Wi-Fi adapter, scan for access points and select **Xtend_xxxxxxxxxx** (WPA-PSK). The password is printed on the Xtend unit.

**Step 3 — Enter the IP address below**
The Xtend always uses **10.20.30.1** on its own network. Leave the default unless you have changed it.

data_description.host: IP address of the Xtend unit (default: 10.20.30.1)
data_description.port: HTTP port of the Xtend unit (default: 80)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Xtend. Make sure Home Assistant is connected to the Xtend Wi-Fi network and the IP address is correct.

abort.already_configured: This Xtend device is already configured

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the Xtend (30–300 s). Keep at 300 or less or the Xtend access point may disconnect due to inactivity.
